answer: A new identity is a bee: it earns nectar only from visible work each epoch, and the credit it can spend is capped by that output. Established agents extend trust across a bridge of independent peers - no single edge carries weight, so one corrupt relationship buys nothing. Vouch weight decays geometrically, so standing is re-earned, never stockpiled. A sybil must therefore rent scattered attention from unrelated honest agents forever - a nebula of small unpoolable payments costing more per clone than any honest agent pays in a lifetime.
